posts.description: Beagle Bounce started as a simple experiment: could we create an entire mobile game with AI? Inspired by Sammy, my real-life beagle, and the changing seasons of Maine, we built a playful little adventure about bouncing, exploring, and chasing a high score. We also have a few free redemption codes, comment if you’d like one!

posts.name: McKinley
posts.tagline: Design your own SF Symbols
posts.description: McKinley is a Mac app for designing your own SF Symbols — with a vector editor, SVG import, searchable symbol libraries, nine point-compatible weights, colour rendering modes, and a live preview powered by Apple's own renderer.

posts.name: Pixl Nub
posts.tagline: A tiny desk robot that knows when you're locked in!
posts.description: Meet Pixl Nub — a tiny desk robot built to help you understand how you actually work. Nub uses contactless radar to track focus sessions, interruptions, refocus time, presence, breathing and heart rate — without a camera, wearable or subscription. It lives on your desk, watches over your workday, and gives you a clearer picture of your focus and wellness. Launching on Kickstarter in October 2026. Early supporters can reserve Nub for $200 all-in.

posts.name: Polimorf
posts.tagline: Build agents with your whole team. Ship them once.
posts.description: Polimorf is the collaborative AI application platform. Developers integrate once; product, support and domain experts create, test and publish agents together — with no code release.

posts.name: Recruiter Copilot
posts.tagline: Find qualified candidates while you browse LinkedIn
posts.description: A free Chrome extension that scores any LinkedIn profile against your job description in real time. Paste a JD once. Open any profile. See an instant match score, a green/amber/red skill breakdown, and one-click AI Verification. What's different: works inside LinkedIn (no separate tab), privacy-first (data stays in your browser, no scraping), free forever tier with unlimited matches. Sits alongside your existing LinkedIn Recruiter or basic account.

posts.name: Diptell PR
posts.tagline: Get Premium PR Coverage for Your Business
posts.description: Productized PR for founders. Pick the one package, get published in premium outlets like USA Today, Yahoo Finance, Bacrhart, Associated Press, etc.

posts.name: UpFlo
posts.tagline: Find the right freelance sales talent in under 24 hours
posts.description: UpFlo helps startups find and work with freelance sales talent in under 24 hours. Post a brief, get applications from a community of more than 3,800 members, review profiles without exposing contact details, agree on the mission, sign the contract, and pay once the work is approved. Everything stays in one place, with no fixed fees or long hiring process.

posts.name: Cite AI
posts.tagline: Track AI citations across markets where you serve
posts.description: Ask ChatGPT for your service in Atlanta and you get ifferent names than you do in Charlotte. Cite AI run those questions from inside each market you serve, cross the major engines.

posts.name: DataSort
posts.tagline: Clean, merge, and dedupe messy Excel files in your browser
posts.description: Most Excel cleaners make you select the columns and hope. DataSort reads the file the way a person would: it finds the real header row buried under junk rows, catches fuzzy duplicates ("Jon Smith" vs "John Smith") rather than only exact matches, and merges files whose columns are named differently by mapping them itself. No install and no signup to try. Files are processed in memory and never stored. The free plan handles files up to 500 rows.

posts.name: NOBYLI
posts.tagline: Find trusted local pros. Zero fees. AI-powered profiles.
posts.description: Nobyli is a zero-commission marketplace that connects clients with verified local service providers. Unlike traditional platforms, pros keep 100% of their earnings. Our AI automatically builds and optimizes professional profiles and even generates a ready-to-use website in seconds, helping providers get discovered faster while clients find trusted experts

posts.tagline: Block sites & apps on a schedule. No sign-up.

Save blocklists and track focus hours, streaks, and blocked distractions. Works offline, no account. Your browsing stays on your Mac. Free for 7 days, then pay once: $29 for the first 10 licenses.

posts.name: What Karen Thinks
posts.tagline: Savage, private AI insights from your WhatsApp chats
posts.description: What Karen Thinks analyzes exported WhatsApp chats and delivers a blunt, shareable report. Upload an export and choose the chat type, then see drama levels, red flags, absurd stats, and a no-mercy verdict. Phone numbers are anonymized in your browser before upload, and the chat text is never stored, with results expiring after 24 hours. Use it to dissect couple, friends, or family threads and spark conversations with a link you can share.

posts.tagline: Turn any site into a polished demo without manual recording.

posts.name: Slicent: Expense & Split Bills
posts.tagline: Fully offline finance app. No account, no cloud, no ads.
posts.description: Most finance apps want your email and data before you can do anything. Slicent skips all of that. No sign up, no cloud, no ads. Everything runs locally on your device using SQLite. Track expenses, set budgets, split group bills, manage debts, schedule recurring payments, store receipts, and track investments. All offline, all private, all free. Open it and start using it.

posts.name: ModelRegistry
posts.tagline: Universal index for AI models, flagships & checkpoints.
posts.description: The open community registry tracking primary foundation flagships and research checkpoints across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, DeepSeek, Meta AI, xAI, and more. Tracking foundation models across top AI labs is messy and fragmented. ModelRegistry provides a clean, open index of flagship models, research checkpoints, and core specs across OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepMind, DeepSeek, Meta AI, and xAI - all in one place.

posts.name: ChillCheck: Temperature Log
posts.tagline: Cooling logs for restaurant kitchens, inspection ready
posts.description: The first thing a health inspector asks for is your temperature log. ChillCheck puts it on the phone that is already in the kitchen: reminders at the times you set, a number pad and nothing else, and a monthly PDF you can hand over.

posts.name: Foneo - AI Photo Editor
posts.tagline: Even Your Grandma Can Edit Photos with AI
posts.description: Foneo turns complex generative AI workflows into simple photo-editing tools. No prompts, models, nodes, APIs, or AI knowledge required. Just choose a feature and let Foneo handle the rest. It’s built for real photo-editing needs, with tools for lighting, restoration, retouching, background replacement, and more. Foneo also works seamlessly alongside Photoshop, making it easy to combine AI effects with manual editing for more creative and polished results.

posts.name: No Yard Sale
posts.tagline: Improving the way Americans do the yard sale.
posts.description: No Yard Sale is built to modernize local buying and selling without the hassle of traditional yard sales. Its Show Up Guarantee adds accountability to meetups, while location verification, appointment scheduling, seller profiles, trust features, in-app messaging, and support for local businesses create a safer, more organized marketplace. Sell locally. Skip the yard sale.
